_notice: Offline, teaching-only CVE reference dataset for Module 5 Lab Day 4. Entries are illustrative and modelled on real, publicly documented ICS vulnerability classes affecting the vendor/product lines used in the Palanca lab (Module 2 asset inventory). Always cross-check against the live NVD (nvd.nist.gov) for real assessments -- this file exists so the lab exercise works without requiring live internet access in the training room.

Siemens S7-1200.summary: Improper authentication in web server component allows unauthenticated configuration read access.
Hard-coded credentials in engineering protocol allow bypass of access controls.

GE Automation.summary: Denial of service via malformed Modbus/TCP request causes RTU watchdog reset.
GE Automation.affected_versions: All versions prior to vendor patch 2023-Q3

ABB REL670.summary: Protection relay web interface vulnerable to cross-site request forgery, allowing unauthorised setpoint changes.

ABB ACS580.summary: VFD control interface accepts unauthenticated Modbus write commands to speed/torque registers.
ABB ACS580.affected_versions: All versions without Modbus write ACL enabled
ABB ACS580.cwe: CWE-306 Missing Authentication for Critical Function

Cisco Cat 2960X.summary: SNMPv2c community string transmitted in cleartext allows credential interception on the management VLAN.
Cisco Cat 2960X.affected_versions: Any configuration using SNMPv2c instead of SNMPv3
Cisco Cat 2960X.cwe: CWE-319 Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information
